title: fix: price Nova Canvas by output dimensions
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Nova Canvas Standard exact AWS dimension tiers: $0.04 when both final dimensions are at most 1024px; $0.06 when either exceeds 1024px.
- Selects pricing from the same 16px-aligned dimensions sent to `amazon.nova-canvas-v1:0`, so requests such as 1025px that normalize to 1024px remain on the lower tier.
- Preserves `nova-canvas`, `amazon-nova-canvas`, Bedrock, `paidOnly: false`, multiplier 1, Pollinations GPU off, and no fallback.
- AWS Cost Explorer evidence for the controlled 2026-08-22 14:00 UTC batch: 3 × 1024 Standard = $0.12 and 4 × 2048 Standard = $0.24. Direct dimensions confirmed `1008×1040` is the higher tier. Source: https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/
- Tests: Gen focused suite (5), Enter cost/snapshot suite (55), Gen and Enter typechecks, Biome.

gist.headline: Canvas math found its ruler
gist.blurb: Nova Canvas now checks the dimensions it actually sends to AWS before picking a price tier. Even pixels like to be measured after they have been neatly trimmed to the grid.
gist.summary: Fixed Nova Canvas Standard pricing to use the same 16px-aligned output dimensions sent to `amazon.nova-canvas-v1:0`: $0.04 at dimensions up to 1024px on both sides, and $0.06 when either aligned dimension exceeds 1024px.
gist.impact: Requests such as 1025px that normalize to 1024px now receive the lower $0.04 tier, while aligned sizes such as 1008×1040 correctly use the $0.06 tier.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Nova Canvas pricing as a cozy pixel-art measuring station: Polli uses a tiny ruler and grid mat to align canvas tiles in 16px increments before placing them into two labeled baskets, "≤1024" and ">1024". A friendly CRT monitor can display neat aligned dimensions and small price tags, with code-plants and flowers growing around the workspace to make the technical accounting feel like careful garden tending.
